name: gameliftstreams
description: Amazon GameLift Streams Amazon GameLift Streams provides a global cloud solution for content streaming experiences.

subcommands.name: add-stream-group-locations
subcommands.description: Add locations that can host stream sessions.

subcommands.name: associate-applications
subcommands.description: When you associate, or link, an application with a stream group, then Amazon GameLift Streams can launch the application using the stream group's allocated compute resources.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates an application resource in Amazon GameLift Streams, which specifies the application content you want to stream, such as a game build or other software, and configures the settings to run it.

subcommands.name: create-stream-group
subcommands.description: Stream groups manage how Amazon GameLift Streams allocates resources and handles concurrent streams, allowing you to effectively manage capacity and costs.

subcommands.name: create-stream-session-admin-shell
subcommands.description: Creates an administrative terminal session with full access to the live runtime environment of the Amazon GameLift Streams stream session.

subcommands.name: create-stream-session-connection
subcommands.description: Enables clients to reconnect to a stream session while preserving all session state and data in the disconnected session.

subcommands.name: create-stream-url
subcommands.description: Creates a stream URL that grants temporary access to a stream session in a web browser without requiring an Amazon Web Services account or client integration.

subcommands.name: delete-application
subcommands.description: Permanently deletes an Amazon GameLift Streams application resource.

subcommands.name: delete-stream-group
subcommands.description: Permanently deletes all compute resources and information related to a stream group.

subcommands.name: disassociate-applications
subcommands.description: When you disassociate, or unlink, an application from a stream group, you can no longer stream this application by using that stream group's allocated compute resources.

subcommands.name: export-stream-session-files
subcommands.description: Export the files that your application modifies or generates in a stream session, which can help you debug or verify your application.

subcommands.name: get-application
subcommands.description: Retrieves properties for an Amazon GameLift Streams application resource.

subcommands.name: get-stream-group
subcommands.description: Retrieves properties for a Amazon GameLift Streams stream group resource.

subcommands.name: get-stream-session
subcommands.description: Retrieves properties for a Amazon GameLift Streams stream session resource.

subcommands.name: get-stream-url
subcommands.description: Retrieves properties for a stream URL, including its current status, usage, and the stream sessions started through it.

subcommands.name: list-application-shader-caches
subcommands.description: Lists the shader caches associated with an Amazon GameLift Streams application.

subcommands.name: list-applications
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all Amazon GameLift Streams applications that are associated with the Amazon Web Services account in use.

subcommands.name: list-stream-groups
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all Amazon GameLift Streams stream groups that are associated with the Amazon Web Services account in use.

subcommands.name: list-stream-sessions
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of Amazon GameLift Streams stream sessions that a stream group is hosting.

subcommands.name: list-stream-sessions-by-account
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of Amazon GameLift Streams stream sessions that this user account has access to.

subcommands.name: list-stream-urls
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the stream URLs in the current Amazon Web Services Region for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves all tags assigned to a Amazon GameLift Streams resource.

subcommands.name: remove-stream-group-locations
subcommands.description: Removes a set of remote locations from this stream group.

subcommands.name: revoke-stream-url
subcommands.description: Revokes a stream URL so that it can no longer start new stream sessions.

subcommands.name: start-stream-session
subcommands.description: This action initiates a new stream session and outputs connection information that clients can use to access the stream.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags to a Amazon GameLift Streams resource.

subcommands.name: terminate-stream-session
subcommands.description: Permanently terminates an active stream session.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a Amazon GameLift Streams resource.

subcommands.name: update-application
subcommands.description: Updates the mutable configuration settings for a Amazon GameLift Streams application resource.

subcommands.name: update-stream-group
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration settings for an Amazon GameLift Streams stream group resource.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: application-deleted
subcommands.description: Waits until an application is deleted It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: application-ready
subcommands.description: Waits until an application is ready It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: stream-group-active
subcommands.description: Waits until a stream group is active It will poll every 30 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: stream-group-deleted
subcommands.description: Waits until a stream group is deleted It will poll every 30 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: stream-session-active
subcommands.description: Waits until a stream session is active It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.
